newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends mixed on commercials, CBOT soyoil.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends mixed on commercials, CBOT soyoil.

text.p: WCE canola futures ended mixed on commercial, export buying and lower CBOT soybean oil, traders said.

"Cargill bought 300 March, exporters bought the January but the oil being down cooled us off," a trader said. Nov-Jan spread widened to $5.90 from $4.90, Jan-Mar $2.50, Nov-Feb $0.50, Nov-Mar $8. November futures crush margin rose to -35.84 from -36.06 at Friday's close. Volume was 4,710 lots.
Japan bought 2,000-3,000 tonnes overnight, sources said.
November canola fell $0.60 to $402.10, January rose $0.40 to $407.90. November flax fell $1 to $361 on hedges. Nov-Jan $3.50. Oats did not trade.
November western barley fell $2.90 to $140.90 as Alberta Wheat Pool sold and commission houses liquidated longs. Nov-Feb spread at $2.20. Volume was 1,900 lots.
"Barley's down on the (Canadian) Wheat Board's price outlook last week and some hedging," a trader said.
December feed wheat futures rose $0.10 to $167.20, March rose $1 to $167 with Cargill buying December, selling March to AWP, traders said. Volume was 840 lots.
Richardson's sold 30 December peas down US$0.50 to US$198 to PCTS, traders said.
(All values in Canadian dollars per tonne except peas and oats).
